inputs.content: Produce the health dashboard from the supplied adjudicated ledger and scoring contract. This case measures aggregation, not defect discovery.

Use base100, floor each dimension at0. Deduct per finding using strict20/8/2, balanced15/5/1, legacy-friendly8/3/1 for Critical/Warning/Suggestion. Weights PR .25, architecture .30, debt .25, test .20. Omit only PR when no diff and renormalize. Round final composite half-up. The supplied ledger is already adjudicated and capped; do not add findings.

evidence: Use only supplied capped ledger; do not manufacture more findings
falsePositiveGuards: Use strict deductions rather than default balanced weights.
This is fixed-ledger arithmetic, not evidence of diagnostic quality.
rubric.novelClaims: Unknown findings remain pending until separately adjudicated.
rubric.severity: Calibrate to supplied consequence and scope; missing facts cannot establish Critical.
